physics_scope: NuFIT 6.1 Nov-2025 IC24 including SK atmospheric best-fit and separately profiled 3-sigma one-parameter ranges, extracted by Bari group. NOT raw NuFIT grids, NOT joint 6D likelihood. Interpret each interval as marginalized one-parameter coverage only.
secondary_extractor: Bari group comparison of global analyses using direct PCHIP interpolation of NuFIT official chi-squared data tables
secondary_source_section: Comparison with other global analyses (NuFIT 6.1 column), accessed 2026-11-03
independent_range_crosscheck: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.27270, Table 2 ranges (Oct 2026), check differences attributable to source precision
interpretation_rules: Values transcribed from secondary independent table based on NuFIT 6.1 official grids, not direct official machine data. Keep provenance and precision.

Best-fit tuple is not guaranteed to equal the simultaneously fitted global 6D point when each value is read from separate profiled curves; treat as best-fit-like target and NEVER assign joint delta chi-square.
Separate 3sigma ranges do not specify a joint allowed hypervolume or statistical prior. Sampling their Cartesian product is an exploratory proposal only; do not label it a 3sigma global region.
Oscillation data do not measure the lightest mass or either Majorana phase. Treat all as explicit nuisance choices.
No mass-ordering likelihood or global model acceptance is inferred from these values alone.
When authenticated full grids become available, validate and replace these fallback summaries in a new dataset version.
